## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /healthcheck/auth` — Check authentication status.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /v1/duos` — Retrieve list of duos (potential matches).
- `GET /v2/{v2Id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /v2/fast-match/teaser` — Get fast match teaser information.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /updates` — Submit updates.
- `POST /v2/buckets` — Store data in a bucket.
- `POST /v2/consents/geo` — Submit geo consent data.

### Media (1)
- `GET /en-GB/{en-GBId}/index.txt` — Retrieve media file.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /ws/generate` — Generate a websocket connection.

### Config (2)
- `GET /en-GB/feature/{featureId}/index.txt` — Get feature configuration.
- `GET /en-GB/feature/plus` — Get Tinder Plus feature configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Tinder's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Tinder data without official API access
- Automate actions on tinder.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Tinder frontend uses
